PART 2 — Claude AI: Where, Which Model, How to Use it
Can you use Claude for FREE?
claude.ai free plan: Limited messages/day. Great for testing agent prompts manually.
Anthropic API: $5 free credit on signup — test thoroughly before spending anything.
Use Gemini Flash (1M tokens/day FREE) for simple tasks. Save Claude for complex/quality-critical tasks.
Your $5 Anthropic credit = ~20,000 Haiku calls or ~1,600 Sonnet calls. Plenty to build and test.
